author: Dawn Benn
text: I use Libre and Omnipod as my insulin pod.  Very happy

author: Dillon Finlay
text: Libre is a  Continuous Glucose Monitor. It can communicate with an insulin pump to let it know your glucose level, but it is not an insulin pump.

author: Julie Pierantoni
text: Libre is a continuous glucose monitor (CGM). It does not hold or administer insulin. It does work with some pumps.
